```{r}
if (!requireNamespace("tidyverse", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("tidyverse")
if (!requireNamespace("caret", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("caret")
if (!requireNamespace("neuralnet", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("neuralnet")
if (!requireNamespace("MASS", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("MASS")
if (!requireNamespace("keras3", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("keras3")
if (!requireNamespace("tensorflow", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("tensorflow")

library(tidyverse)
library(caret)
library(neuralnet)
library(MASS)
library(keras3)
library(tensorflow)

data("Boston")
data <- Boston
data <- subset(data, select = -c(rad))

str(data)
summary(data)

set.seed(123)
train_index <- createDataPartition(data$medv, p = 0.75, list = FALSE)

train_raw <- data[train_index, ]
test_raw  <- data[-train_index, ]

cat("Training size:", nrow(train_raw), "\n")
cat("Testing size:", nrow(test_raw), "\n")

# normalize variables using training-set statistics
train_means <- sapply(train_raw, mean)
train_sds   <- sapply(train_raw, sd)

train_scaled <- as.data.frame(scale(train_raw, center = train_means, scale = train_sds))
test_scaled  <- as.data.frame(scale(test_raw, center = train_means, scale = train_sds))

medv_mean <- train_means["medv"]
medv_sd   <- train_sds["medv"]

unscale_medv <- function(x_scaled) {
  x_scaled * medv_sd + medv_mean
}

get_test_mse <- function(pred_scaled, true_scaled) {
  pred_orig <- unscale_medv(pred_scaled)
  true_orig <- unscale_medv(true_scaled)
  mean((pred_orig - true_orig)^2)
}

# Q2 neural network with no hidden layer
set.seed(123)

nn_q2 <- neuralnet(medv ~ ., data = train_scaled,hidden = 0,err.fct = "sse",linear.output = TRUE)

plot(nn_q2, rep = "best")

pred_q2_scaled <- predict(nn_q2, test_scaled) %>% as.vector()
mse_q2 <- get_test_mse(pred_q2_scaled, test_scaled$medv)

cat("Q2 Test MSE =", mse_q2, "\n")

# Q3 neural network with one hidden layer (3 neurons)
set.seed(123)

nn_q3 <- neuralnet(
  medv ~ .,
  data = train_scaled,
  hidden = 3,
  err.fct = "sse",
  linear.output = TRUE
)

plot(nn_q3, rep = "best")

pred_q3_scaled <- predict(nn_q3, test_scaled) %>% as.vector()
mse_q3 <- get_test_mse(pred_q3_scaled, test_scaled$medv)

cat("Q3 Test MSE =", mse_q3, "\n")

# Q4 multiple linear regression
lm_q4 <- lm(medv ~ ., data = train_scaled)

summary(lm_q4)
coef(lm_q4)

pred_q4_scaled <- predict(lm_q4, newdata = test_scaled) %>% as.vector()
mse_q4 <- get_test_mse(pred_q4_scaled, test_scaled$medv)

cat("Q4 Test MSE =", mse_q4, "\n")

mse_compare <- data.frame(
  Model = c(
    "NN no hidden layer",
    "NN hidden layer (3 neurons)",
    "Multiple Linear Regression"
  ),
  Test_MSE = c(mse_q2, mse_q3, mse_q4)
)

mse_compare

true_medv <- unscale_medv(test_scaled$medv)
pred_q2 <- unscale_medv(pred_q2_scaled)
pred_q3 <- unscale_medv(pred_q3_scaled)
pred_q4 <- unscale_medv(pred_q4_scaled)

plot(
  true_medv, pred_q2,
  pch = 16, col = "blue",
  xlab = "True MEDV",
  ylab = "Predicted MEDV",
  main = "Predicted vs True Values"
)

points(true_medv, pred_q3, pch = 17, col = "red")
points(true_medv, pred_q4, pch = 15, col = "darkgreen")

abline(0,1,lty=2,lwd=2)

legend(
  "topleft",
  legend = c("NN no hidden", "NN hidden=3", "MLR"),
  col = c("blue","red","darkgreen"),
  pch = c(16,17,15)
)

plot(
  pred_q4, pred_q2,
  pch = 16,
  col = "purple",
  xlab = "MLR prediction",
  ylab = "NN (no hidden) prediction",
  main = "NN vs MLR predictions"
)

abline(0,1,lty=2,lwd=2)

# Q5 neural network with ReLU hidden layer using keras3
x_train <- as.matrix(train_scaled[, colnames(train_scaled) != "medv"])
y_train <- as.numeric(train_scaled$medv)

x_test <- as.matrix(test_scaled[, colnames(test_scaled) != "medv"])
y_test <- as.numeric(test_scaled$medv)

set_random_seed(123)

nn_q5 <- keras_model_sequential(input_shape = ncol(x_train)) |>
  layer_dense(units = 3, activation = "relu") |>
  layer_dense(units = 1, activation = "linear")

summary(nn_q5)

nn_q5 |>
  compile(
    optimizer = optimizer_adam(),
    loss = "mse",
    metrics = list("mse")
  )

history_q5 <- nn_q5 |>
  fit(
    x = x_train,
    y = y_train,
    epochs = 200,
    batch_size = 32,
    validation_split = 0.2,
    verbose = 0
  )

plot(history_q5)

pred_q5_scaled <- predict(nn_q5, x_test) |> as.vector()
mse_q5 <- get_test_mse(pred_q5_scaled, y_test)

cat("Q5 Test MSE =", mse_q5, "\n")

pred_q5 <- unscale_medv(pred_q5_scaled)

plot(
  true_medv, pred_q5,
  pch = 16,
  col = "orange",
  xlab = "True MEDV",
  ylab = "Predicted MEDV",
  main = "ReLU neural network vs true values"
)

points(true_medv, pred_q4, pch = 15, col = "darkgreen")

abline(0,1,lty=2,lwd=2)

legend(
  "topleft",
  legend = c("ReLU NN","MLR"),
  col = c("orange","darkgreen"),
  pch = c(16,15)
)

final_results <- data.frame(
  Model = c(
    "NN no hidden layer",
    "NN hidden layer (3 neurons)",
    "Multiple Linear Regression",
    "NN hidden layer (ReLU)"
  ),
  Test_MSE = c(mse_q2, mse_q3, mse_q4, mse_q5)
)

final_results
```
